title: c00lkidd Gotcha
blurb: "Gotcha!" is the line every Forsaken survivor learns to dread, chirped in that unbothered sing-song way that makes losing feel personal rather than mechanical. c00lkidd's whole design refuses to take the horror seriously, and neither should you, right up until the moment he is on top of you. The clip travelled far beyond the game because it works as an audio full-stop for any prank, ambush or reveal. Use it the instant somebody falls for something. Then use it again when they fall for it twice.
origin: c00lkidd's catch line from the Roblox game Forsaken.
